scripts.dev: sh -c 'adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081 2>/dev/null || true; expo start --clear'
scripts.dev:install: npm run build:apk:dev:install && npm run reverse
scripts.dev:run: npm run dev:install && npm run dev
scripts.build:apk:dev: sh -c 'SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}"; [ -d "$SDK" ] || { echo "Android SDK nao encontrado. Instale o SDK ou defina ANDROID_HOME."; exit 1; }; printf "sdk.dir=%s\n" "$SDK" > android/local.properties; cd android && bash ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug'
scripts.build:apk:prod: sh -c 'SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}"; [ -d "$SDK" ] || { echo "Android SDK nao encontrado. Instale o SDK ou defina ANDROID_HOME."; exit 1; }; printf "sdk.dir=%s\n" "$SDK" > android/local.properties; cd android && APP_ENV=production ./gradlew clean :app:assembleRelease'
scripts.build:aab:prod: sh -c 'SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}"; [ -d "$SDK" ] || { echo "Android SDK nao encontrado. Instale o SDK ou defina ANDROID_HOME."; exit 1; }; printf "sdk.dir=%s\n" "$SDK" > android/local.properties; cd android && APP_ENV=production ./gradlew clean :app:bundleRelease && echo "AAB gerado em: android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab"'
scripts.build:apk:dev:install: npm run build:apk:dev && npm run adb:install-dev-apk
scripts.build:apk:prod:install: npm run build:apk:prod && npm run adb:install-prod-apk
scripts.adb:install-dev-apk: sh -c 'APK="${APK_PATH:-android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk}"; adb get-state >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Nenhum dispositivo ADB conectado."; exit 1; }; [ -f "$APK" ] || { echo "APK nao encontrado em: $APK"; exit 1; }; adb install -r "$APK"'
scripts.adb:install-prod-apk: sh -c 'APK="${APK_PATH:-android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk}"; adb get-state >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Nenhum dispositivo ADB conectado."; exit 1; }; [ -f "$APK" ] || { echo "APK nao encontrado em: $APK"; exit 1; }; adb install -r "$APK"'
